title.zh: 修订第 1200 号、第 1411 号与第 1613 号共和国法特定项目的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items of Republic Acts Numbered Twelve Hundred, Fourteen Hundred Eleven and Sixteen Hundred Thirteen
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items of Republic Acts Numbered Twelve Hundred, Fourteen Hundred Eleven and Sixteen Hundred Thirteen
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 1200, Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 1411 và Đạo luật Cộng hòa số 1613
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขเพิ่มเติมพระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 1200 พระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 1411 และ พระราชบัญญัติแห่งสาธารณรัฐที่ 1613
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Republik No. 1200, Undang-Undang Republik No. 1411 dan Undang-Undang Republik No. 1613
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta Republik No. 1200, Akta Republik No. 1411 dan Akta Republik No. 1613

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1758_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item (39), page two hundred one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(39) Cainta public plaza, including purchase of site ₱5,000.00"

Item (c), page three hundred twenty of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(c) Drilling artesian well in Ganutan Cardona ₱1,000"

Item (d), page one hundred twenty-nine of Republic of Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(d) Cainta public plaza, including purchase of site ₱5,000.00"

Item 52, page one hundred ninety-one of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"52. Acquisition and repair of Juan Sumulong Memorial High School building for use as annex of the Central Elementary School Taytay ₱10,000"

Item (3), page two hundred eighty-eight of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(3)-a Construction or improvement of San Joaquin-Calawan road, Pasig, Rizal ₱10,000" "(3)-b Asphalt paving of A. Mabini street, Marikina, Rizal 10,000" "(3)-c Improvement of Villalon street, Marikina, Rizal 5,000"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
